title: Concrete Pirate Signal
description: A driving 160bpm UK dance-pop cut that comes in hot on a chopped LinnDrum breakbeat and a bright square-wave arp hook, then deconstructs itself across the back half. Jungle-leaning ratchets and an opening filter leave a tight pocket for a rap to ride before the kit strips back to a lone pulsing arpeggio.
code:
setcpm(160/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    n("0 2 4 7").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.45).lpf(900).room(0.3).delay(".4:.1875:.4"),
    s("hh*8").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.4).degradeBy(0.3).cut(1)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.0),
    s("hh*8").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).degradeBy(0.2).cut(1),
    n("0 2 4 7 <0 5> 7 4 2").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.5).lpf(saw.slow(24).range(700, 3200)).room(0.25).delay(".4:.1875:.4")
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.0).ply("<1 1 1 2>"),
    s("hh*8").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).degradeBy(0.15).cut(1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.6).room(0.2),
    n("0 2 4 7 <0 5 -2 3> 7 4 2").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.55).lpf(3000).room(0.25).delay(".4:.1875:.4"),
    n("<0 0 -3 -1>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").decay(0.25).sustain(0.2).gain(0.55).lpf(600)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.0).ply("<1 2 1 4>"),
    s("hh(7,8)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).cut(1),
    s("~ oh ~ ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.45).cut(1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.6).room(0.2),
    n("7 9 11 12 <7 14> 12 11 9").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.5).lpf(4000).room(0.3).delay(".4:.1875:.5"),
    n("<0 0 -3 -1>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").decay(0.25).sustain(0.2).gain(0.6).lpf(800)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    n("0 2 4 7 <0 5> 7 4 2").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.5).lpf(sine.slow(16).range(500, 2800)).room(0.5).delay(".5:.25:.6"),
    s("~ cp ~ ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).room(0.5),
    n("<0 -3>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").decay(0.3).sustain(0.3).gain(0.5).lpf(500).room(0.3)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.0).ply("<2 1 4 8>").every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("hh(7,8)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).cut(1).ply("<1 1 2 1>"),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.6).room(0.2),
    n("0 2 4 7 <0 5 -2 3> 7 4 2").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.55).lpf(4000).room(0.3).delay(".4:.1875:.5"),
    n("<0 0 -3 -1>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").decay(0.25).sustain(0.2).gain(0.6).lpf(900)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    n("0 2 4 7").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.45).lpf(sine.slow(16).range(600, 1800)).room(0.4).delay(".4:.1875:.4"),
    s("hh*8").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.35).degradeBy(0.4).cut(1)
  )]
)
